name: nexus-lexi-translation-pricing
title: Nexus translation pricing for Lexi
description: Keep Nexus translation and image-assist capabilities affordable, preserve operator pricing, hide the detailed client price table, and keep routine request telemetry out of INFO logs.
creator: TalexDreamSoul
notes: User feedback replaced the initial expensive defaults before final archival: text translation is 10 credits/1K tokens; OCR/image translation defaults are 10/20/30; CoreApp keeps balance and billing guidance without a detailed price table.

meta.verification: Nexus pricing tests passed 95/95; CoreApp credits-summary tests and the signed-in no-price-table component test passed; focused lint, Nexus/CoreApp typechecks, CoreApp build, and packaged UI inspection passed.
